title: Kaluza-Klein tower thresholds and scheme dependence of the species scale
summary: We revisit the species scale in quantum gravity from the viewpoint of effective field theory (EFT). Two common parametric characterizations relate it to the breakdown of perturbative gravity and to the suppression scale of higher-derivative gravitational operators. We examine their correspondence through local threshold corrections from infinite Kaluza-Klein (KK) towers. In four dimensions, we compute the four-derivative one-loop action of minimally coupled scalar and Dirac towers with KK spectra in graviton, radion, and photon backgrounds.
